categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the smart city and digital economy sectors, providing comprehensive digital solutions. Main business segments include: (1) Smart City Information System Integration - offering integrated solutions for city governance, smart livelihood, and public safety; (2) Financial Security System Integration; (3) Design, R&D and Technical Services; (4) Self-developed Product Sales including intelligent digital platforms and smart education software; and (5) Operation and Maintenance Services. The company leverages IoT, big data, AI, cloud computing, and digital twin technologies to serve government agencies, state-owned enterprises, and large corporations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include: (1) Intelligent video analysis technology; (2) IoT and intelligent perception technology; (3) Big data processing and analysis; (4) AI large model application and intelligent agent construction platform; (5) Digital twin and CIM (City Information Model) technology; and (6) 5G and satellite communication integration. Production methods involve system integration services combining hardware platform construction, software development, system integration, and operation & maintenance. The company has developed proprietary intelligent digital platform products and AI intelligent agent construction platform (HTS Agent) that support private data embedding and industry knowledge integration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are government agencies, state-owned enterprises, public institutions, and large corporations. Key end markets include: (1) City governance and management services; (2) Smart livelihood (buildings, venues, education, finance); (3) Public safety and ecology (public security, geological disaster monitoring, smart irrigation); (4) Digital economy and AIGC applications. The company serves customers in multiple sectors including municipal infrastructure, water utilities, transportation, education, healthcare, and financial institutions, with strong market presence in Southwest China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Southwest China with strong presence in Sichuan Province. As of 2024, domestic revenue was 263.7 million yuan (69.59% of total), with 115.2 million yuan (30.41%) from outside Sichuan. The company has expanded operations to provinces including Xinjiang, Shandong, Hunan, and Chongqing. Recent expansion includes establishing subsidiaries in Guangdong Province, indicating geographic diversification beyond traditional Southwest base.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the smart city industry value chain. It provides system integration services, software development, and operation & maintenance services rather than manufacturing hardware components. The company sources hardware from suppliers and integrates them with self-developed software and platforms to deliver complete solutions to end customers (government and enterprises). This positions the company as a solution provider and systems integrator rather than a hardware manufacturer or pure software vendor.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) Deepening AI large model application and intelligent agent development; (2) Expanding smart city solutions in city governance, smart livelihood, and public safety domains; (3) Advancing data governance and AIGC application innovation; (4) Developing intelligent digital platform products and industry-specific applications; (5) Extending into smart city operation and maintenance services; (6) Pursuing geographic expansion beyond Southwest China. R&D focuses on AI intelligent agent construction platform, digital twin technology, city information models, smart drainage systems, and intelligent inspection robots for underground pipelines.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through multiple streams: (1) System Integration Services (92.74% of 2024 revenue) - project-based contracts for designing, developing, and implementing smart city solutions with revenue recognized upon project completion and customer acceptance; (2) Financial Security System Integration (4.85%); (3) Design, R&D and Technical Services (1.55%); (4) Self-developed Product Sales (0.52%) - licensing and selling proprietary software platforms; (5) Operation & Maintenance Services (0.31%) - recurring revenue from system maintenance and support. Revenue recognition occurs at project completion for integration services and upon delivery/acceptance for products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the smart city and digital economy sectors against both large national IT companies and regional competitors. The company positions itself as a specialized solution provider with strong advantages in Southwest China, particularly in smart corridor management, water utilities, and city governance. Competitive advantages include: 20+ years of industry experience, comprehensive resource qualifications, landmark project cases, and early-mover advantage in smart corridor technology. The company acknowledges that brand recognition and national market presence lag behind larger competitors, though recent IPO and increased marketing efforts aim to address this gap.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized software and IT services provider. 2024 revenue was 378.9 million yuan, down 8.71% from 415.1 million yuan in 2023, reflecting market challenges. Net profit attributable to parent company was 46.1 million yuan (down 27.28% YoY). Total assets reached 1.79 billion yuan at year-end 2024. The company went public on Shenzhen Stock Exchange in July 2023, raising 87.8 million yuan in net proceeds. Growth trajectory shows maturation with seasonal patterns - H2 revenue concentration due to government budget cycles. The company maintains strong balance sheet with 989.4 million yuan in cash.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's value proposition centers on: (1) Comprehensive integrated solutions combining hardware, software, and services rather than point solutions; (2) Deep industry expertise in smart city applications with 20+ years of experience and landmark project cases; (3) Advanced technology stack integrating AI large models, big data, IoT, and digital twin capabilities; (4) Strong qualifications and certifications (highest-level smart building design qualifications, CMMI Level 5); (5) Specialized focus on underserved segments like smart corridor management and city lifecycle infrastructure; (6) Intelligent agent construction platform (HTS Agent) enabling rapid AIGC application deployment with lower barriers. Differentiation emphasizes industry-specific solutions, technical depth, and ability to bridge AI technology with traditional city governance needs.
